opening_annotation.data_driven_name: Fast Zergling Speed with Early Expansion
opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Early Zergling speed upgrade to enable aggressive ling/bane pressure while expanding quickly.
supporting_facts: The opening has a high rate of first combat unit observed (94.9%) compared to baseline (69.8%), indicating early combat unit production.
The opening has a high rate of first upgrade observed (88.7%) compared to baseline (12.7%), indicating a fast early upgrade.
The medoid key sequence shows early Spawning Pool, Gas, and Base (expansion), followed by ling/bane and Zergling Movement Speed upgrade.
The opening has a high winrate of 58.98% with 2716 supports.
